list.name: Quick Claw
list.summary: At the beginning of the round, it deals damage to the entire enemy team as a percentage of the target's current HP and has a chance to stun the target for 1 round, and your team gains 1 round of Stun Res Effect. The higher the level, the faster the strike, and the same level, the challenger strikes first.

skills.text: Deals 5% damage to all enemies at the target's current life value and stuns 1 random target for 1 round at a 15% chance, cast first round, cooldown 4 rounds

Deals 8% of the target's current life value to all enemies, stuns 2 random targets with 20% chance for 1 turn, and increases the stun resistance of your party to Quick Claw by 15% for 1 turn, cast on the first turn, cooldown 4 turns

Deal 10% of the target's current HP damage to all enemies, and make 3 random targets 25% chance of being stunned for 1 round, and increase the stun resistance property of your party to Quick Claw by 18% for 1 round, cast on the first round, cooldown 4 rounds

Deals 12% of the target's current life to all enemies, stuns 4 random targets with a 30% chance for 1 round, and increases the stun resistance of your party to Quick Claw by 28% for 1 round, cast on the first round, cooldown 4 rounds

Deals 15% damage to all enemies at the target's current life, stuns 5 random targets at 35% for 1 round, and increases the stun resistance of your party to Quick Claw by 40% for 1 round, cast on the first round, cooldown 4 rounds

list.name: Guardian Shield
list.summary: At the beginning of the round, all units on allied receive a shield of the average percentage of the HP of Pokémons on the line. The shield cannot be dispelled and disappears when it is broken or blocked, and at the end of the round, it restores our Pokémon's HP as a percentage of the damage absorbed.

skills.text: Apply shield to all allies at the start, the value of which is 15% of the average HP of deployed Pokémons. The shield disappears after being broken or after blocking 2 times damage, and lasts for 1 turn. Restores 30% of the damage absorbed by the respective shield at the end, with a cooldown of 4 rounds.
